name: RTX 5080: Qwen3 32B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q4_K_M quantization, 16GB VRAM
notes: RTX 5080 with 16GB GDDR7 at 960 GB/s. A 32B model at Q4_K_M requires ~18GB of VRAM, which exceeds the 16GB capacity. This benchmark assumes some layers offloaded to CPU. With full GPU offload, a 32B model at Q4_K_M does not fit in 16GB. The RTX 5080 is best suited for models up to ~16B at Q4_K_M.
